# ASan Reporter retirement removes its shipping pipeline while separate sanitizer jobs remain configured

The patch removes the Linux and Windows shippable ASan Reporter build producers, their reporter mozconfigs and reporter-specific packaging/signing mappings. Separate current ASan and Linux ASan-fuzzing jobs still select their own variants. Symbol upload additionally changes from-deps grouping from platform to single-with-filters; its taskgraph processor was not inspected, so task cardinality and filtering are not inferred from that name. The release-history fixture cleanup and static task declarations do not establish a generated graph, sanitizer run or artifact delivery.

Scope: Thunderbird ASan Reporter task retirement.
